Intended use: Rank assets by 30-day failure risk to prioritise proactive maintenance visits; exposed to agents as the `asset_failure_risk` tool.
Data: 5652 monthly snapshots; time split + 20% of assets held out entirely. Train base rate 0.109.
Selected: logreg (higher PR-AUC). The synthetic hazard is logistic in its features, so a linear model matching the generating process is expected to compete; on real telemetry with interactions, boosting usually wins.
Registry: promoted v1 to champion (pr_auc=0.3268 vs None)
Limitations: Synthetic hazard: real telemetry (pressure, temperature, cycles) is far noisier.
Snapshots of the same asset are correlated; CIs need cluster bootstrap.
Survival framing (time-to-failure) would use censored data better.
